results.rationale: Consistency: excluding the requested reduction to two bananas, the remaining fruit have different outlines and positions, and the shared brown stem has become two separated stems; the checkerboard background is also visibly coarser. Instruction: the original three-fruit bunch becomes exactly two recognizable yellow bananas, matching the expected count completely. Quality: structural coherence ✔, natural appearance ✔, artifact-free ✔, texture fidelity ✔; both fruits have continuous curved silhouettes, plausible shading and intact brown tips, without noticeable generation defects.

Consistency: excluding the requested ball color change, the ball position and size, purple tee, foreground grass, distant trees, fairway and sky remain visually unchanged. Instruction: the white ball becomes black with gray highlights while retaining its recognizable spherical, dimpled form; this fully matches the expected black golf ball. Quality: structural coherence ✔ and natural lighting ✔; the ball and tee are coherent, but texture fidelity ✘ for a small flattened, smeared patch across the ball crown interrupting the otherwise distinct dimples. No other noticeable artifacts.
